verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is a SaaS virtual-mailbox service, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence mentions only general APIs for connecting the mailbox to other tools, which are developer building blocks rather than an MCP server. Nothing in the pack documents an MCP server or endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
